Name: Balanced Quarry for Farms
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
[b][u]+ Note - this is effectively deprecated as I have uploaded a new mod combining all of the improved quarries - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20956]Better Quarries[/url] +[/u][/b]

+

Takes the well-made values of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13250]Balanced Quarry[/url] (old link broken) and also applies them to the farm quarries on Hilltop and Four Corners.

I have reduced the spawn rate to account for the smaller size of the quarries.

Balanced Quarry gives 3-6 spawns per day in the Mountain Quarry.
Balanced Quarry for Hilltop gives 2-4 spawns per day in the Hilltop Quarry.
Balanced Quarry for Four Corners gives 1-2 spawns per day in the Four Corners Quarry.

+
